title: SCOPE: Scalable Training-Free Semantic Coreset Selection for Long-Tailed Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.12976v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scientific discovery increasingly relies on federated learning over data from high-resolution instruments, and these data are strongly non-IID and long-tailed. Coreset selection could shorten training, but existing federated coreset methods either prune with local heuristics that ignore the global class distribution, or first train a warm-up model at every client and upload class centroids of its features. This makes coreset selection a distributed bottleneck that consumes GPU time at every client, grows with the model and the number of clients, and must be repeated for every architecture. We introduce SCOPE, named for Semantic Coreset using Orthogonal Projection Embeddings, a scalable, training-free federated coreset framework for long-tailed data. translated_title: SCOPE：面向长尾联邦学习的可扩展免训练语义核心集选择
translated_abstract: 科学发现日益依赖于对高分辨率仪器数据的联邦学习，而这些数据呈现出强烈的非独立同分布和长尾分布特性。核心集选择可以缩短训练时间，但现有的联邦核心集方法要么使用忽略全局类别分布的局部启发式方法进行剪枝，要么先在每个客户端训练一个预热模型并上传其特征的类别质心。这使得核心集选择成为一个分布式瓶颈：在每个客户端消耗GPU时间，随模型规模和客户端数量的增长而扩展，并且必须针对每种架构重复进行。我们提出了SCOPE（基于正交投影嵌入的语义核心集），这是一个面向长尾数据的可扩展、免训练的联邦核心集选择框架。每个客户端使用一个冻结的紧凑视觉-语言模型对其样本进行一次性评分，并上传每类的标量统计信息。服务器将这些信息合并为全局类别画像，从而……
tldr: SCOPE提出了一种免训练的联邦核心集选择框架，各客户端仅用冻结的轻量视觉-语言模型对样本评分一次并上传每类标量统计量，服务器据此构建全局类别画像，从而为长尾非独立同分布数据提供可扩展、无需GPU训练的核心集选择方案。
en_tdlr: SCOPE is a scalable, training-free federated coreset selection framework for long-tailed, non-IID data, where each client scores its samples once with a frozen compact vision-language model and uploads per-class scalar statistics, allowing the server to build a global class profile without any GPU training overhead.
